source_name: Dataset for Beyond Double-Double Theory: n-Directional Stacking Sequence Optimisation in Composite Laminates
publication: Beyond Double-Double Theory: n-Directional Stacking Sequence Optimisation in Composite Laminates, Composite Structures 373, Article 119586, 2025
dataset_type: Optimization software/results code; not experimental measurements

units.ply_thickness: m in source code, converted from 0.005 in
units.load_Nxx_load_Nyy: lb/in in source comments, converted in code to N/m

description: Research code for 48- and 64-ply symmetric/balanced laminate stacking-sequence optimisation under uniaxial/biaxial compressive loading.
transformations_performed: Downloaded raw Zenodo files unchanged into raw folder.
Created metadata and inventory only; no source data values modified.
Parsed constants from source code without executing optimization scripts.
limitations: Source is software/optimization output, not experimental data.
Source provides stiffness properties E11/E22/G12/nu12 and ply thickness in code.
Source uses strain allowables from Haftka 1993 rather than Xt/Xc/Yt/Yc/S stress allowables required by current Maximum Stress implementation.
Full reproduction requires external packages composites, bfscplate2d, scipy, and pymoo.
Current project CLT can use stiffness card for ABD/stress calculations, but optimization remains not ready until reference validation and objective alignment are completed.
